raw_text: Mandiant has completed analysis of the PLC-targeting malware discovered in an Indian chemical facility. The malware, which we track as INCONTROLLER.V2, represents the most sophisticated ICS-specific attack tool discovered since TRITON/TRISIS. Attribution analysis with moderate confidence links the development to a state-sponsored threat actor. The malware's capability to bypass safety instrumented systems poses significant risk of physical damage or hazardous material release.
